question: Should this draft Claw update-planning CLI/schema continue as the next core RFC slice after the workspace safety bugs are fixed, or should it pause until the open Claws apply/doctor stack settles?
rationale: The patch adds a new public CLI and JSON plan contract on top of open prerequisite state/apply work, so final landing order and contract shape require maintainer intent after the mechanical blockers are addressed.

options.title: Fix Safety Contracts Then Continue
options.body: Require known workspace roots and all-owner workspace conflict checks, then keep the PR in the Claws stack for normal maintainer review.

options.title: Pause Until Stack Settles
options.body: Leave the draft open but defer acceptance until the prerequisite Claws apply and doctor PRs establish the final persisted state contract.

options.title: Rework The Update Surface
options.body: Replace this CLI/schema slice if maintainers want Claw update planning behind a different command, plugin, or RFC boundary.

recommendation.title: Fix Safety Contracts Then Continue
recommendation.body: Require known workspace roots and all-owner workspace conflict checks, then keep the PR in the Claws stack for normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is about core CLI/product surface and stack landing order rather than only code mechanics.
